hooks.command: export PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; f=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))"); case "$f" in *app.js|*sw.js) d=$(dirname "$f"); b=$(basename "$f"); cd "$d" && /System/Library/Frameworks/JavaScriptCore.framework/Versions/A/Helpers/jsc "$b" 2>&1 | grep -v 'navigator\|variable: self\|global code@' | head -5; eslint "$b" 2>&1 | tail -15 ;; esac; exit 0
